answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 808 Country: Pakistan Title: Is Namaz-e-Fajir ka waqt kab tak rehta hay awr kaysay check kray gay. I have bleeding broblem from my nose (right cavity),even in wazu if I put the water in it its bleeding, plz tell me without pouring water in my nose my wazu will be completed? Question: My Q-1, is Namaz-e-Fajir ka waqt kab tak rehta hay awr kaysay check kray gay. Q-2. I have bleeding broblem from my nose (right cavity),even in wazu if I put the water in it its bleeding, plz tell me without pouring water in my nose my wazu will be completed? Answer ID: 808 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 303/L) (1) The time of Fajr Salah ends at sunrise. As soon as the side of the sun appears the time of Fajr Salah comes to an end. This can either be observed personally or known by reliable calendars: وقت صلاة الفجر من اول طلوع الفجر الثانی وھو البیاض المنتشر المستطیر لا المستطیل الی قبیل طلوع ذکاء بالضم ۔۔۔ اسم الشمس (الدر المختار مع الشامی: 2/14) (2) The Wuzu will be valid. In Wuzu , it is only sunnah to inhale water not compulsory. There is problem if anyone leaves it due to some reason: (وغسل الفم) ای استیعابہ (بمیاہ) ثلاثة (والالف) ببلوغ الماء المازن (بمیاہ) وھما سنتان مؤکدتان (الشامی: 1/236) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
